description:
Pollen (birch, alder, olive, grass, mugwort, ragweed, in grains/m³ with a level) and air quality (European and US AQI, PM2.5, PM10, ozone, NO2) now and for up to 4 days. Air quality: worldwide. Pollen: Europe only, during the pollen season (says so honestly elsewhere).
Use when: hay fever, allergy, "pollen count in Brussels", "is the air quality bad in Delhi today", smog, asthma, outdoor sport.
Example: {"location":"Brussels","days":2}
Data: CAMS (Copernicus) forecasts via Open-Meteo (CC BY 4.0). Free, no API key.

lang.description: Language of the place name, default en

location.description: City, address or landmark in any language, or "lat,lon"

name: pollen_and_air_quality
title: Pollen and air quality for any place
